policy.active_definition: An active entry has non-skeletal source, expected behavior, executable local checks, a negative/error path, and an explicit supported target/profile.
policy.release_rule: Use --require-complete for a release intended to claim the full practical corpus. Pending classes are never counted as passing evidence.

entries.behavior: Runs ten deterministic update ticks, prints final position 55, then exercises an invalid-score path and prints -1.
Compiles bounded fixed-iteration control logic with an explicit divide-by-zero-safe error path and no host imports, externs, dynamic allocation or IO.

entries.blocker: The public reference runtime does not yet expose application argv, so an argument-parsing CLI would be simulated rather than real.
The reference desktop ABI has no HTTP listen/accept/respond service implementation yet.
Requires the real HTTP host boundary before request/JSON/status integration can be release evidence.
NoqeriDB has its own executable path, but the ordinary application runtime does not yet expose a persistent DB service for a real app corpus entry.
Requires real socket/HTTP upgrade host services rather than parser-only coverage.
The reference desktop ABI does not yet expose bounded filesystem read/write services to ordinary programs.
The reference desktop ABI does not yet expose listen/connect/read/write/timeout socket services.
A supported GUI host adapter with event/input/render services is not yet part of the release runtime.
